quotes.text:
The comm-central definitions in `comm/mail/metrics.yaml`,
`comm/mail/pings.yaml` and `comm/mail/tags.yaml` are used _in addition_ to
their mozilla-central counterparts..

As part of the mozilla-central telemetry build process, scripts are used to
generate the C++ files which define the probe registry (enums, string tables
etc).

Because of this code generation, the extra comm-central probe definitions
need to be included when the mozilla-central Glean is built.

This is done by setting `MOZ_GLEAN_EXTRA_*` config values. You can
see these in `comm/mail/moz.configure`.
These config values are used by `toolkit/components/glean/moz.build`
(mozilla-central) to pass the extra probe definitions to the code
generation scripts.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The migration removed old Events.yaml, Histograms.json, Scalars.yaml and their obsolete build-configuration test probes. Thunderbird metrics and tags now enter Gecko’s Glean generation through MOZ_GLEAN_EXTRA_* configuration. Current configure also registers component metrics files and lists interesting Gecko metrics needed by tests and product features. Update build inputs, tests and documentation together when removing a probe system. Current documentation still contains older prefix wording, so it is not evidence that every metric needs a tb prefix. No configure or build was run.
title: Register migrated probes in Glean build inputs and retire obsolete test probes
